subject: ScalingPilot: timebox extension vs prepay bridge — procurement asks
messages:
From: ScalePilot Procurement <procurement@scalepilot.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: short runway extension or credit top-up (ScalePilot PoC)

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from procurement — our pilot run with Redwood is finishing next week and engineering needs an extra 3 weeks to validate the 1M-token throughput tests. Two questions:

1) Can you offer a 21-day extension to the current timebox? If so, what does that cost and does it come with the current trial support SLA?
2) Alternatively, can we top up credits (token bucket) instead of extending days? If we prepay now for an extra 300k tokens can we get a small discount?

Separately, our leadership is willing to discuss an early-commit if we agree on a path to a 6-month reserved commitment after the PoC — what discount would Redwood consider for an early commitment (we're talking committed capacity, not enterprise-only pricing)?

Procurement + legal will need a short amendment; can you share a draft and any pricing matrix so we can run numbers?

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Procurement Lead, ScalePilot

Attachment: none
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: ScalePilot Procurement <procurement@scalepilot.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short runway extension or credit top-up (ScalePilot PoC)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and congrats on how quickly the team moved through the integration. High level options below (happy to jump on a quick call):

Option A — Timebox extension (21 days)- Keeps current trial terms and support SLA in place- Fixed fee: EUR 6,500 for the 21-day extension (covers burst capacity and 24/7 incident response)

Option B — Credit top-up (token bucket)- 300k token top-up at list price EUR 0.022/token = EUR 6,600; we can offer a 7% top-up discount if paid upfront (EUR 6,138)

Option C — Early-commit path (preferred for ScalePilot leadership)- If you commit to a 6-month dedicated capacity agreement within 21 days post-PoC, we can offer a 8% commitment discount on monthly committed spend plus waived onboarding fee. This would require a signed amendment + 6-month SOW.

Next steps I suggest: I can share a short amendment draft and a pricing matrix (attached) showing the math for each option. Kimberly from pricing/legal is looped for any adjustments. If procurement prefers a mixed approach (partial prepay + short extension) we can structure that too.

I'll attach a pricing spreadsheet and a starter amendment. If you want DocuSign I can send that link once you confirm an option.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, redline_amendment_draft.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short runway extension or credit top-up (ScalePilot PoC)

Jonas — quick pricing/legal input. I'm OK with Option B discount but propose we soften the early-commit from 8% to 6% and add a milestone: if they commit and hit the pilot-to-prod migration by month 3, we'll honor an additional 2% rebate (paid retroactively).

Two additional asks:
- Need the amendment to reference our standard data residency and audit clause (they're EU-based).
- Finance prefers a 40% prepay on any committed contract (rest monthly). For short extensions/top-ups we can accept full prepayment or standard PO plus net30.

I've attached a redlined amendment template that includes the milestone rebate language and the finance prepay term.

Kimberly Park
Director, Pricing & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_amendment_draft.pdf
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@scalepilot.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ScalePilot Procurement <procurement@scalepilot.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T17:58:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short runway extension or credit top-up (ScalePilot PoC)

Thanks Jonas and Kimberly — useful framing. Procurement prefers Option B (credit top-up) with the 7% prepay discount but we have two follow-ups:

1) Can you confirm the token definition and whether 300k tokens covers our peak scenario based on the attached sample traffic? (I'll send sample logs to engineering).
2) If we instead do a shortened extension of 14 days + 150k token top-up, is there a blended price you can offer? We are able to prepay 40% upfront as finance asked.

Assuming we can get a clean amendment and a signed DocuSign within 48 hours we'll route payment. Alyssa

On Wed, Aug 12, 2026 at 11:04 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and congrats on how quickly the team moved through the integration. High level options below (happy to jump on a quick call):
>
> Option A — Timebox extension (21 days)
> Option B — Credit top-up (token bucket)
> Option C — Early-commit path (preferred for ScalePilot leadership)
>
> I'll attach a pricing spreadsheet and a starter amendment. If you want DocuSign I can send that link once you confirm an option.

Attachment: none
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@scalepilot.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, ScalePilot Procurement <procurement@scalepilot.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short runway extension or credit top-up (ScalePilot PoC)

Alyssa — thanks, good questions. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Token definition: we use tokenization consistent with the open-source tokenizer family used by the model (roughly tokens ~= words for your workload profile); engineering looked at the sample traffic and 300k tokens covers the reported peak plus a 20% buffer.

2) Blended option (14 days + 150k tokens): we can offer EUR 3,900 for the 14-day extension + EUR 3,150 for the 150k token top-up (list) and apply a 6% blended prepay discount if you prepay 40% now. Blended prepaid total = EUR 6,366.

Action items:
- I'm going to send the redlined amendment via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef-ScalePilot-Extension) — it includes the finance 40% prepay term, milestone rebate language, and data residency reference Kim called out.
- If procurement confirms the blended path I'll prepare an invoice for the 40% prepay and mark the deal DP-48219 in HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DP-48219).
- I'll also attach the pricing matrix and a short one-page SOW for the 6-month early-commit path if leadership wants to evaluate that.

If that works, please confirm and we will route the DocuSign. Happy to jump on a 15min call if you want to walk through numbers.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, redline_amendment_draft.pdf
